correctness.rationale: All conics are smooth in any characteristic. Exact local expansions give contact length three at the unique common-tangent multiple point and length one at the ordinary multiple point. Their invariant characterization forces an upper triangular projective matrix, so the induced parameter map is affine. Sharp two-transitivity forces a finite subfield. Frobenius product and direct differentiation yield a primitive cubic polar triple; the source function field is a quadratic extension of the target, separable precisely when p != 2. Burnside count derives from exact affine cycle types. verify.py replays independent small-field instances; sampling is not used for unbounded assertions.

value.rationale: A published pencil of free curve arrangements has a complete geometric moduli and automorphism classification with an exact maximal symmetry locus. The maximal symmetry locus is sharply finite-field and forces an exceptionally small polar degree for a degree-2q divisor, with an inseparability jump in characteristic two. The closed finite-field geometric-orbit census supplies a natural exact invariant across the family. These are motivated structural boundaries, not isolated arbitrary small computations.
